name: Cedarwood (Virginia)
source_reference: PMID 29326032 - The anxiolytic effect of Juniperus virginiana essential oil; NTP Technical Report (CASRN 8000-27-9)
notes: Virginia cedarwood differs from Atlas (Cedrus atlantica) and Texas (Juniperus mexicana). Sesquiterpenes are the dominant compounds. True cedars (Cedrus) contain himachalenes and atlantones.
